verses.text: Sing the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, everyone on earth!
Sing to the LORD and bless his name! Day after day, tell people how he saves.
Tell the nations about his glory. Let every people hear what wonders he’s done.
The LORD is great and deserves all that praise! He’s to be feared above every god.
The gods of the nations are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
Honor and majesty stand before him. Strength and beauty fill his sanctuary.
Give the LORD glory and strength, you families of the nations. Give him the credit he deserves.
Give the LORD the glory his name deserves. Bring an offering and come into his courts.
Worship the LORD in holy splendor. Tremble before him, all the earth.
Tell the nations, “The LORD reigns!” The world stands firm. It won’t be moved. He’ll judge the peoples fairly.
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar with everything in it!
Let the fields and everything in them celebrate! Then every tree in the woods will sing for joy
before the LORD, because he’s coming. He’s coming to judge the earth. He’ll judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with his truth.
